backlinks.label: Mentioned in
dlg.importFolder: Choose the folder with your notes
dlg.vault: Choose the folder where your notes will be stored
draw.title: Drawing
editor.hint: Pick a note from the list or start a new one with
empty.none.d: Create the first one with “New note”.
empty.smart.d: Change the rules by right-clicking the smart folder.
empty.tag.d: Type #{tag} inside a note to tag it.
empty.trash.d: Notes you delete will show up here.
folder.deleteNotes.one: Its note will go to the trash, where you can restore it for 30 days.
folder.deleteNotes.other: Its {n} notes will go to the trash, where you can restore them for 30 days.
folder.mustKeepOne: At least one folder must remain.
help.card.folders.how: Create folders and, by right-clicking a folder, subfolders. Drag a note from the list onto a folder to move it.
help.card.history.how: Libreta saves a version every 5 minutes of editing. Pick a date, see how the note looked and restore it; what was there before is kept too.
help.card.history.t: Go back to an earlier version
help.card.history.where: “…” menu of the editor (top right) → Version history
help.card.import.how: It accepts folders of Markdown, text or HTML (Joplin, Obsidian, Bear, Notion) and Evernote files (.enex). Apple Notes has to be exported first with a separate tool.
help.card.import.t: Bring your notes from another app
help.card.insert.how: You can also paste or drag images and files straight into the note. The scanner uses your camera and lets you choose between Document, Grayscale and Color.
help.card.insert.t: Insert images, files, drawings and scans
help.card.insert.where: Editor toolbar: image, paperclip, pencil and scan frame
help.card.links.how: Type “[[” and pick another note (or create a new one). At the bottom of each note, “Mentioned in” lists the notes that link to it.
help.card.lock.how: The note is encrypted on disk. If you forget the password there is no way to recover it, and images and attachments are not encrypted.
help.card.lock.t: Lock a note with a password
help.card.lock.where: Padlock icon in the editor toolbar
help.card.search.how: It ignores accents and forgives typos. Try filters like tag:ideas or has:image (“Search” tab). A search can be saved as a smart folder.
help.card.search.where: Search box of the notes list
help.card.settings.how: Choose a light or dark theme (or your system’s), an accent color, the language, the typeface and size of your note text, the page width and the list view. Changes show up instantly.
help.card.settings.where: File → Settings… (Ctrl + ,) or the “Settings” button in the sidebar
help.card.share.how: Copy as text or Markdown, send by email, or export to PDF, HTML or Markdown.
help.card.smart.how: They automatically gather the notes that meet your rules: with checklists, with images, with a tag, with certain text… They show up under “Smart”.
help.card.updates.how: Every few hours Libreta checks GitHub for a new version and tells you with a card in the corner; nothing is installed unless you accept. It only reads the list of versions and never sends your notes. You can turn the check off in Help → Check for updates automatically.
help.card.vault.how: Each note is a file. You can change the folder from File → Change notes folder and sync it with Syncthing, Nextcloud or Dropbox.
help.card.vault.t: Your notes are your own files
help.f3.d: Notes with images (also tasks, attachment, table and link)
help.f5.d: Edited before that date (after: for the opposite)
help.k10.k: Delete (with the note selected in the list)
help.searchIntro: Type in the list search box. Accents and capitalization don’t matter, and typos are forgiven. You can combine several filters.

import.folder.d: Markdown, text or HTML with subfolders, images and attachments. Works for Joplin, Obsidian, Bear and Notion, and for Apple Notes if you first export it with a third-party tool (Apple Notes can't export on its own).

lock.warn: If you forget the password, nobody can recover the note. Images and attachments are not encrypted.

welcome.intro: Your notes are files in a folder of your own: you decide where it lives and what you sync it with. Here is what you can do and where to find it.
welcome.tags: Type tags like #ideas or #todo and they will show up on the left for filtering.
welcome.task2: Check off this task by clicking the circle
welcome.task3: Type [[ and link to another note
welcome.task4: Drag a note from the list onto a folder
welcome.task5: Press “New…” (bottom left) and create a subfolder or a smart folder
welcome.title: Welcome to Libreta
welcome.where1: Editor toolbar: formatting, checklists, table, link, image, file attachment, drawing, scanner, lock and pin.
welcome.where2: “…” menu (top right): version history, share, export and move.
welcome.where3: Search: ignores accents and forgives typos. Try has:image or tag:ideas.
welcome.where4: File → Import notes: bring your notes from Joplin, Obsidian, Evernote and more.
welcome.where5: Settings (Ctrl + ,): light or dark theme, color, typeface and text size.
welcome.where6: Help → Quick guide (or the F1 key): all of this in more detail.
